updates.note: Management stated full year EBITDA margin for FY26 was 20.8%.
updates.quote: And, EBITDA growth margin is for the year 20.8%.

updates.note: Management noted Q4 FY26 had a revenue growth of 1.8% in constant currency and 1.9% quarter-on-quarter in terms of dollar.
updates.quote: we had a good Q4. I think we had a growth of 1.8% in constant currency 1.9% quarter-on-quarter growth in terms of dollar.

updates.note: Reiterated positive growth outlook for FY27.
updates.quote: positive environment in FY27. I must say that all across we are seeing a good traction.

new_promises.statement: Expect EBITDA margin to be between 20.5% and 21.2% in FY27.
new_promises.quote: EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil

new_promises.statement: Expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solutions and products in FY27.
new_promises.quote: We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil

new_promises.statement: Expect solutions and products revenue share to move to 60% in 3 years.
new_promises.quote: this 15% is solution and product, which will move to 60% in 3 years.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil

new_promises.statement: Expect EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% in the medium term.
new_promises.quote: So we expect the EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% from where we are today.
new_promises.speaker: Kishor Patil
